text: Per the Super Bock Group's own About us page, with a Portuguese majority, 56% of the Super Bock Group's capital is owned by the VIACER Group and 44% by the Carlsberg Group.
short: Super Bock Group capital: 56% VIACER Group, 44% Carlsberg Group.

source.name: Super Bock Group - About us (Quem Somos)
source.quote: With a Portuguese majority, 56% of the Super Bock Group's capital is owned by the VIACER Group and 44% by the Carlsberg Group
source.note: Quote as shown on the page, minus the final full stop. The Portuguese version reads: 'Maioritariamente português, o capital do Super Bock Group é detido em 56% pelo Grupo VIACER e em 44% pelo Grupo Carlsberg.'
